Initial release of hermes-guard – an active quality assurance system for AI Agents.

- Adds Completion Gate for real-time multi-dimensional output quality scoring and interception.
- Integrates Escape Pod feature for automatic tool stubbing/registration when tools are missing.
- Includes self-correcting loop (CORRECTION-as-Code) that learns from errors and updates rules.
- Provides daily health checks for tools and supports fast local integration.
- CLI and Python API available for auditing agent outputs and enforcing quality safeguards.
